title: add a test that every name in renderFixtureNames appears in the UI brief's fixture list

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The UI pass brief tells the UI role which `-render-fixture` names it can ask for (`internal/engine/brief.go:233`). That list is typed by hand and has drifted from `renderFixtureNames` (`internal/cli/render_test.go:428`). The matrix-copy fixtures `matrix-copy-preview`, `matrix-copy-ask` and `matrix-copy-stale-preview` are in `renderFixtureNames` and in `renderViews`, but the brief does not name them. A UI pass reading only its brief cannot know it can render them.

No test ties the two lists together, so this drift went unnoticed. This slice adds a test in the CLI package, which already imports `engine`, that builds the UI brief and requires every name in `renderFixtureNames` to be in its fixture list. It also adds the three missing names to the brief so the test passes. The test compares exact names, not substrings, because `wave-start` is a substring of `wave-start-finding` and `projects-set` of `projects-set-refusals`.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/cli/render_test.go:428-457` (renderFixtureNames and TestUIPassBriefListsEveryRenderFixture)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:233` (UI fixture sentence)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go:1084-1097` (TestUIPassBriefNamesRenderFixtures comment and expected sentence)
- `docs/guide.md:1004-1009` (UI review finding: synchronize optional fixture names)
- `docs/design.md:834-839` (UI review finding: synchronize optional fixture names)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestUIPassBriefListsEveryRenderFixture` (internal/cli/render_test.go:430; renderFixtureNames at :428): build engine.BuildBrief with RoleUI and minimum SliceID, Worktree, TempDir, ReportPath and SliceJSON. Cut after The names are the five above (without .txt) and and before . Copy the views; fail if either delimiter is missing. Split comma-separated and final and-separated names into an exact-name set. Assert every renderFixtureNames entry is present; initially fail on matrix-copy-preview, matrix-copy-ask and matrix-copy-stale-preview.
- `TestUIPassBriefNamesRenderFixtures` (internal/engine/brief_test.go:1086, expected list at :1097): update the exact expected fixture list before product code and observe failure until the brief includes the three matrix-copy names.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/cli/render_test.go`, write `TestUIPassBriefListsEveryRenderFixture` as described under Failing tests. Use `strings.Cut` for the sentence and `strings.Split` plus a trim of the leading `and ` for the names. Run it and see it fail on the three matrix-copy names.
2. In `internal/engine/brief.go:233`, change the fixture sentence. Keep `wave-start-finding` last, after ` and `, and add the three names before it: `... projects-setup, fake-reply, matrix-copy-preview, matrix-copy-ask, matrix-copy-stale-preview and wave-start-finding.` Change nothing else in the line.
3. In `internal/engine/brief_test.go:1097`, update the expected substring to the new list. In the comment at line 1085, change "the eight fixtures it adds" to match the list.
4. Run the new test and `TestUIPassBriefNamesRenderFixtures` and see both pass. Run `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .`.
5. Write the slice's changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S607 --text "..."`, as AGENTS.md says. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefListsEveryRenderFixture ./internal/cli` exits 0 after the change. Before the change it fails, naming matrix-copy-preview, matrix-copy-ask and matrix-copy-stale-preview.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefNamesRenderFixtures ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestRenderCLIViewsWritesFiles ./internal/cli` exits 0 (the fixture list itself is unchanged).
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go vet ./...` prints nothing and exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
